mechanism: Modafinil inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, potentially increasing irbesartan plasma concentrations and enhancing hypotensive effects; modafinil may also increase heart rate and blood pressure, partially counteracting irbesartan's antihypertensive effects.
action: Monitor blood pressure regularly during concurrent use; counsel patient on orthostatic hypotension risk; consider dose adjustment of irbesartan if blood pressure becomes suboptimal.
